anti_posthoc_rule: No additional frontier carrier may be introduced after this registry is frozen unless it is separately predeclared before use for a reason independent of observed coupling outcomes.

frontier_carriers.reflection_structure: one fixed diagonal state (k+1,k+1) and k off-diagonal two-element orbits

frontier_carriers.orbit_structure: one fixed orbit plus k off-diagonal pair orbits

frontier_carriers.definition: count raw frontier incidences by orbit multiplicity
frontier_carriers.multiplicity_rule: fixed orbit contributes 1; every off-diagonal orbit contributes 2
frontier_carriers.warning: This is an abstract count only and is not a primary-step correspondence.

phase_conventions_predeclared.activation_index: A_k=min{n:a_n=k}, when level k is reached
phase_conventions_predeclared.jump_edge: J_k is the single primary edge C_k -> A_(k+1) when A_(k+1) is finite

allowed_coupling_tests: exact bijection from a predeclared finite primary gap event set to raw frontier states
reflection-equivariant map to swap orbits plus independently proved incidence multiplicity with one primary step per raw incidence
exact recurrence proving that the k->k+1 transition consumes all and only 2k+1 frontier incidences
forbidden_shortcuts: desired square threshold used to define GAP_k
coordinate-derived jump-event set used as the frontier coupling itself
